business_rules.amount: Use SUM(amount) for gross transaction volume. Do not add status filters unless explicitly requested or required by a defined business metric.
business_rules.signed_amount: Use SUM(signed_amount) only when calculating net transaction flows.
business_rules.currency: If the user specifies a currency, filter fact_transactions.currency accordingly. Never aggregate different currencies without conversion.
business_rules.transaction_status: Apply transaction_status = 'completed' only when the user explicitly requests completed transactions or a business metric explicitly requires it.
